{{Quote|That was… That was… Unbelievable.|Unidentified [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] reacts to Chewbacca killing Pooches|<ref name="Rebel Heist 4" />}}
'''Pooches''' was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] owned by an [[Unidentified Human female (Imperial planet)|unidentified Human female]] aligned with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] building on a [[Unidentified planet (reptilian species)|backwater planet]]. During the [[mission to steal a DSS-02 shield generator]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and his [[Unidentified stormtrooper (DNA codes)|partner]] were captured by this woman and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in the building's rancor pit.<ref name="Rebel Heist 3">[[Rebel Heist 3|''Rebel Heist'' 3]]</ref> However, Chewbacca managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Pooches using an [[Axe/Legends|axe]], much to the woman's ire. Shortly thereafter, Chewbacca and his partner were rescued by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Rebel Heist 4" />
